question: Mo kept 229 beads in his craft jar. He added 19 beads from a broken necklace and 53 beads from a new packet. His friend Nia had 8 times as many beads as Mo. Nia then bought 69 more beads at the craft fair. How many beads did Nia have?

A farm's water tank holds 224 gallons. The tank is 2 metres tall. The farmer measures water in pints, and since a gallon is 8 pints, he wrote down the tank's contents in pints. He drew off 1285 pints for the cattle, then a rain shower added 73 pints. He drew off another 479 pints for the vegetable beds, and a leaking pipe dripped 3 pints back into the tank. How many pints of water were in the tank?

Ollie has 47 nickels in his piggy bank. His sister Pia has twice as many nickels as Ollie. Since a nickel is worth 5 cents, Pia worked out the value of her nickels in cents. She then added 42 cents in pennies to her savings and spent 134 cents on a comic. How many cents does Pia have left?

Bea's jar held 102 nickels. Her aunt dropped in 70 more nickels and her uncle added 10. The jar is 20 centimetres tall. Since a nickel is 5 cents, Bea counted her savings in cents, and then found 18 cents in loose pennies to add. Over the next 5 weeks she saved exactly that same amount every week. How many cents did Bea save over those 5 weeks?

In the morning a print shop ran off 51 sheets with 8 stickers on each sheet for a school. In the afternoon an assistant added 67 leftover stickers from an earlier job and 24 stickers that had been returned. In the evening the school asked for 9 times that quantity, because the order was for 4 branches of the school and had to be repeated for 4 weeks of the term. How many stickers did the print shop have to supply in all?

Ken picked 203 cherries from the tree in his garden and his mother picked 48 more. The cherry tree is 30 years old. They threw out 2 cherries that were bruised and gave 147 cherries to the neighbours. The rest were shared equally among 6 cousins, including Lia. Lia ate 16 of hers straight away, while Ken kept his own share untouched, so Ken had more left than Lia. How many cherries did Lia have left?

In the morning Zed had 57 dollars in his wallet. He spent 16 dollars on breakfast, then was paid 78 dollars for a morning of yard work. In the afternoon he spent 64 dollars on new shoes. In the evening he found 8 dollars in an old coat pocket, and his friend Yara, who had less money than Zed, paid him back the 6 dollars she owed him. How many dollars did Zed have at the end of the evening?

A hotel ordered 74 square yards of carpet, then cancelled 32 square yards of the order. Since a square yard is 9 square feet, the supplier wrote the order up in square feet, and the hotel then added an 80-square-foot runner for the stairs. The client phoned a couple of times to confirm. The hotel wants the identical carpet on each of its 9 floors. How many square feet of carpet does the supplier need to deliver?

A scout troop's cookie stock started at 18 boxes with 8 cookies in each box. A second delivery of exactly the same size arrived, which doubled the troop's stock. A parent then dropped off a dozen home-baked cookies to add to it. Another parent added 44 more. How many cookies did the troop have?

Otto's market stall had 99 candles, more than his sister Una's stall had. He unpacked 80 more candles from his van. Before the festival he restocked so that he had 7 candles for every candle already on the stall. On the opening day he sold 845 candles, and that night he made 22 more. Over the following 7 days he sold exactly that many candles each day. How many candles did Otto sell over those 7 days?

Dee is a dozen years old and has been saving nickels. Her piggy bank weighs 3 pounds. She counted 144 nickels, and since a nickel is 5 cents she worked out her savings in cents. She then spent 684 cents on a paperback. From then on she saved that same amount every day, 7 days a week, for 9 weeks. How many cents did Dee save over those 9 weeks?

Pam baked 84 pies on each of 7 days for the county fair. Each pie weighs 800 grams. She sold 338 pies at the fair. A cafe returned 3 unsold pies to her, and a friend gave her 43 pies to sell. Quinn's bakery stall had 4 times as many pies as Pam had then. How many pies did Quinn's stall have?

Ola had 15 marbles. Her brother Bo had twice as many marbles as Ola. Bo won 37 marbles at recess, then lost 18 in a game after school. His uncle gave him 66 marbles for his birthday. How many marbles did Bo have then?

Vera's nursery had 106 seedlings, more than Will's nursery had. She took cuttings so that she ended up with triple the number of seedlings. She then bought 8 more. Every seedling grew into a plant with 4 stems, and every stem bore 7 flowers. How many flowers did Vera's plants produce?

Abe kept 208 buttons in a jar. He gave 112 buttons to his cousin Cal and sold 71 at a craft fair. Cal then had triple the number of buttons that Abe had left. Cal bought 40 more buttons. How many buttons did Cal have?

Dot collected 91 shells on the first day of her holiday and 67 more on the second day. The beach is 5 kilometres long. Her friend Eve collected 2 times as many shells as Dot. Eve then found 33 more shells in a rock pool and 11 more on the path home. How many shells did Eve have?

A bean packet holds 230 seeds, and a gardener sowed 3 packets. The plot is 20 metres wide. Of the seeds sown, 43 failed to sprout. Every plant that grew produced 8 pods, every pod held 5 beans, and every bean was split into 2 halves for drying. How many bean halves did the gardener dry?

A nursery had 218 lavender seedlings, and 139 of them were sold at the spring fair. The nursery employs 6 people. From every remaining seedling the staff took 9 cuttings, each of which was potted up as a new plant. A grower donated 62 lavender plants, and 17 more arrived from a supplier. How many lavender plants did the nursery have?

Ian brewed 63 quarts of lemonade for the fair but 36 quarts were spilled when his cart hit a kerb. His friend Jo brewed 2 times as many quarts as Ian had left. Jo serves lemonade by the cup, and since a quart is 4 cups, she worked out how many cups she had. A friend then gave her 47 more cups of lemonade. How many cups of lemonade did Jo have?

Priya's coffee cart took 158 dollars on its first shift, plus 31 dollars in tips. Her cart is 4 metres wide. She works 2 shifts a day and takes in the same amount on each shift, and she does this for 5 days a week. At the end of one week a customer gave her a 63-dollar bonus. She matched that whole weekly total in each of 7 weeks. She then shared the amount from those 7 weeks equally among her 3 business partners, herself included. How many dollars was Priya's share?

In the morning a dairy had 29 gallons of milk in its tank, all from a single herd, and the afternoon milking added 51 gallons. Since a gallon is 8 pints, the dairy records the day's milk in pints. The dairy produced the same amount every day for 7 days. In the evening of the last day the regional co-op added up its 9 dairies, which all produced exactly the same. How many pints of milk did the co-op's dairies produce in those 7 days?

In the morning 225 crates of water were delivered to a marathon, with 5 bottles in each crate, and volunteers added 65 loose bottles. In the afternoon the organisers worked out that each of the 5 aid stations needed exactly that many bottles, and that the same would be needed at each of the 8 races in the series. In the evening a sponsor added 19 bottles to the total order. How many bottles did the organisers order for the series?

A community hall had 199 chairs, and the trust that runs it bought 33 more for that hall. The trust owns 5 identical halls in the town, each with the same number of chairs, and it runs the same set-up in each of its 4 towns. Each chair weighs 6 kilograms. The trust then sold 1833 chairs as surplus and sent 2458 chairs to storage. How many chairs did the trust have left in use?

A nature trail was 168 yards long, and the rangers extended it by 73 yards. Since a yard is 3 feet, the new trail sign gives the length in feet. A 50-foot stretch was later closed after a landslide, and a 45-foot boardwalk was added at the far end. How many feet long is the open trail now?

Dee's shop had 128 six-packs of soda, and since each six-pack holds 6 cans, she counted her stock in cans. Over the weekend she sold 669 cans. Her rival Eli had 6 times as many cans as Dee had left. Eli divided his cans equally between his 2 branches. The east branch then sold 84 cans. How many cans did the east branch have left?
